build.command: pnpm exec tsc -b apps/crm-web/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vite build --config apps/crm-web/vite.config.ts

build-test.command: pnpm exec tsc -b apps/crm-web/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vite build --mode proofline-test --config apps/crm-web/vite.config.ts

build-demo.command: pnpm exec tsc -b apps/crm-web/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vite build --mode proofline-demo --config apps/crm-web/vite.config.ts

coverage.command: node tools/proofline/canonical-runner.mjs vitest run --config apps/crm-web/vite.config.ts --coverage && node tools/proofline/canonical-runner.mjs vitest run apps/crm-web/scripts/demo.test.ts --coverage --coverage.all --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reportOnFailure --coverage.reportsDirectory=artifacts/coverage/crm-demo --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=html --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.include='apps/crm-web/scripts/*.mjs'
